extension.summary: No scrolling. No deciding. Just watching.
extension.description: Tired of scrolling through your library wondering what to watch? EasyTV handles it. It tracks your shows and always knows your next episode. When you're ready for something new, it'll suggest a show you haven't started. Throw in some movies if you want. Just sit down, press play, and enjoy. Built for Kodi 21+.
extension.news: v1.8.0 (2026-09-02) - New setting: choose whether a repeated show is spread out or truly random, under "Allow multiple episodes of same TV Show" - Fixed a part-watched premiere disappearing from an in-progress list on your other device - Fixed missing artwork for a show added on another device - Renamed the launch dialog's "Surprise me" button to "Start playlist" so it no longer clashes with Surprise Me in the browse views - Faster launch: show artwork is fetched once per Kodi session instead of every time you open EasyTV - Faster launch: EasyTV no longer waits on the background service when it is busy
